title: HHHusher hero (v2)
description: A full-window dark hero: a looping product film fills the screen, and along the bottom edge sit a two-line medium-weight headline (from 40% across on desktop) and, at the right, a short paragraph over three buttons: a soft-glass play square, a cream-glass link and the yellow buy. The text rises in on load; the film drifts down at half speed as you scroll away.
notes: always dark (forces the dark class); the media slot takes a video or image, cropped like object-fit: cover
CSS only: load-in keyframes and a scroll-driven parallax, both off under reduced motion
